what.en: A disease outbreak is when many more people than usual get sick with the same illness. Germs can spread fast from person to person.
what.fil: Ang pagkalat ng sakit ay kapag mas marami kaysa karaniwan ang nagkakaroon ng parehong sakit. Mabilis na kumakalat ang mikrobyo mula sa isang tao papunta sa iba.

signs.en: DOH announces an outbreak on the news. Many classmates may be absent, or more people around you may have fever, cough, or diarrhea.
signs.fil: Inaanunsyo ng DOH ang outbreak sa balita. Maaaring maraming kaklase ang liban, o mas maraming tao sa paligid ang may lagnat, ubo, o pagtatae.

before.en: Practice proper handwashing, eat healthy food, and drink plenty of water. Keep tissues and a face mask in your bag.
before.fil: Mag-ensayo ng tamang paghuhugas ng kamay, kumain ng masustansyang pagkain, at uminom ng maraming tubig. Magdala ng tissue at face mask sa bag.

during.en: Wash your hands and cover your cough! Scrub with soap for 20 seconds, and cough into a tissue or your elbow. Stay home if you're sick.
during.fil: Maghugas ng kamay at takpan ang ubo! Magsabon nang 20 segundo, at umubo sa tissue o sa siko. Manatili sa bahay kung may sakit ka.

after.en: If you get a fever or feel sick, tell an adult right away. Rest at home until you are well, and keep following DOH advice.
after.fil: Kapag nilagnat o masama ang pakiramdam, sabihan agad ang nakatatanda. Magpahinga sa bahay hanggang gumaling, at patuloy na sundin ang payo ng DOH.

signoff.en: Remember: wash your hands, and cover your cough!
signoff.fil: Tandaan: maghugas ng kamay, at takpan ang ubo!
